limitations: No human geometry approval; scaffold conforms only to the explicitly proposed contract.
Straight runs are technically consistent; D1/D2 upper-rail continuity remains unresolved and must be judged separately.
Ground elbow mask is reference-only topology, not a visible adapter or asset.

tests.method: Complete-suite subprocess output; count parsed from pytest summary

visual_review.method: Direct inspection of the independently saved geometry review montage and local corner diagnostic; no production approval
findings: The shallow 14 px band is visibly narrower than the approved 20 px solid-side carrier. Its flat pane remains readable at enlargement and in the wall context; native-scale suitability is a human design decision.
Separate colored test areas and yellow objects remain visible through the pane. The declared exterior areas show the separate background rather than baked artwork.
Two- and four-cell runs have single opaque support bands with no doubled seams in the valid assembly.
The local corner resembles a connected base-level L, but the D1 elevated top frame does not continue into a demonstrated side elevation. The marked 28 px head transition remains unresolved.
The proposed 4x8 ground-mask completion is displayed separately. It is not drawn over the scene and does not hide the visible corner problem.
visual_review.limits: Pixel conformance and topology coverage are separate computed evidence. These recorded visual findings are not automatic feature detection or a human approval. No final appearance, all-junction validation, or production readiness is claimed.
